vna.chat.model.description: The ollama tag 💬 Steer chat asks for (C198: gemma for the control chat, qwen for local subagents — both settable on ⚙️🔑 Engine & Keys) until you pick one in its selector. A tag that is not installed is shown as not installed — never silently swapped for another.

vna.refreshOnSave.description: Re-run the Steer cockpit 1.5s after a save. Off by default: the pipeline walks the chip and writes shared cache, so the panel is a per-turn read-out, not a live linter.

vna.showStatusBar.description: Show the last walk's placement in the status bar. Reads data/vna/cockpit.json; shows "not run" when no walk has been run rather than a number.

thetacog.panelHome.description: Where YOUR encircled panels are served from (C506) — a base URL, or JSON { "base", "pattern", "tree" } with {sha10} in the pattern. Empty = read .thetacog/panel-home.json, else derive from your git origin (a GitHub fork of thetacog → https://raw.githubusercontent.com/<owner>/<repo>/<branch>/). The backup manifest carries it so 🔭 3rd party viz shows your panels next to the tapes.

enumDescriptions: The backup carries your encircled panel PNGs and the backup store serves them (C647b). Nothing is published anywhere else.
As backup, plus your repository's GitHub raw URL as a second address — ONLY when an anonymous check at backup time finds the repository public. A private repository's raw URL is never named.
Carry no panels and name no address; the tape slider says panels are off.
thetacog.panels.home.description: Where your encircled panels live (C647n): backup (default) · repo (adds your public repo's raw URL, after a visibility check — never assumed) · off. Read by scripts/vna/panel-home.mjs as VNA_PANELS_HOME, or from this workspace's .vscode/settings.json.

vna.authBase.description: Authorization server base for the device flow (device · token · keys). Empty = https://thetadriven.com/api/auth.

thetacog.betaSurfaces.markdownDescription: Developer surfaces (beta): the 🎯 Steer HUD and the 💬 Steer chat. Off by default; they exist to feed the instrument data from live dictation. Reveal them from the link at the foot of 📈 Optimisation Targets, or **Steer: Show / hide the beta surfaces**.
